score_method: Rounded category means across all four actual images; every output retained and none regenerated.

outputs.name: Nested lens seats
evidence: nested retaining seats read as functional detail
outputs.limitation: Lotus relationship is subtle enough to approach generic premium camera detailing.

outputs.name: Layered crossbar
evidence: best visible two-level rigid camera assembly
rose body and cool background remain restrained and coherent
outputs.limitation: The intended centre lift is visible mainly as an enclosure step rather than a distinctive emergence relationship.

outputs.name: Chamfer opening
evidence: continuous chassis with no detached corner caps
three real lenses and subordinate flash remain legible

schema_learning: Explicit body-continuity constraints prevented the prior case-like failures across all four outputs. Rigid nested camera layers are the strongest visible Lotus carrier; optical finish fields remain ambiguous unless the schema names a real appearance-driving process and its visual signature. User feedback requires the next schema to include concrete process names that influence visible result, not generic material adjectives.
